title: TeVeS (Tensor–Vector–Scalar gravity, Bekenstein)
efc_relevance: Relativistic completion of MOND with three fields (gμν, Uμ, φ). Explained galactic RC but failed CMB acoustic peaks without additional dark matter; superseded by RMOND. Positioned relative to EFC as a historical relativistic-MOND attempt — EFC achieves galactic MOND-limit without extra fields, using entropic flow on existing metric.
ledger_action: Logged as historical relativistic-MOND reference. Kept for recovery-condition comparison (WP1).
